'''Tsar'alla''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who, along with the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Glorificent]], was a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] dancer to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She often lounged at the foot of Nem'ro's seat in [[Nem'ro's Palace|his palace]], wearing a [[Huttese slave-girl costume]] and a [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collar]].
